user_settings.why: one row per account, read on every surface that account signs in to

account_security_settings.why: second factor and allowed networks follow the person, not the workspace

email_preferences.why: what we may send the person, keyed by their address

organization_admin_policies.why: the tenant's own defaults, the base every narrower layer narrows

organization_model_policies.why: which providers and models the tenant permits at all

organization_connector_policies.why: which connectors, plugins and MCP hosts the tenant permits at all

organization_domain_retention_policies.why: how long each domain's rows are kept, decided by the tenant

organization_policy_overrides.why: the layering table: subject_type carries the narrower scope, mapped by WORKSPACE_POLICY_SCOPE_SETTINGS_SCOPE

organization_policy_revisions.why: the rule version an effective value is quoted against
